Make this clearly a different form: a stout ancient ironwood treant with a broad fused trunk, heavy dark bark plated forearms, a hollow amber heartlight, four root feet and a small crown of deep green leaves. Calm determined green eyes; friendly collectible fantasy style. Full body, centered, facing slightly right, square composition, generous clear margins, crisp enough to read at 70 pixels. Transparent background with real alpha. No words, no frame, no ground, no scenery, no magenta. This is one solid melee attacker, not a guardian pair; no weapons or shields.
